findings.description: A viewer who opens /expenses/<id>/edit directly gets the full edit form (HTTP 200) and can submit it: POST /expenses/<id> returns 303 to /expenses?flash=updated and the amount really changes in the list and total. Add, delete and POST /expenses are correctly refused with 403, but editing is not.
repro: Change the amount to 21.00 and click Save
Observe 'Expense updated' and the Notebooks row and total change

notes: List total, category filter, add (flash, one new row, persists on reload), edit (list and total update immediately), and server validation of bad amount/title/category all behaved correctly. Not tested: delete as editor, long-title layout, concurrency.

cost.notes: estimate from 73118 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0146-$0.1755
